_about: Canonical example payload for POST /api/script/generate. Every source type, including clips, is submitted as the single broker job type 'script.generate'. This example uses a text source, Italian output, a 400-word target and save_to_db=false. To request a Google Doc, provide items[0].output.drive_folder_id or export VELOX_DOC_FOLDER before running the command. Prerequisites: a fresh Drive token at token.json and a writable destination folder when document creation is requested. No real folder ids are committed. The _run and _poll values are stand-alone shell examples. VELOX_ADMIN_TOKEN must come from scripts/with-velox-auth or a canonical ~/.env; historical placeholders like test-admin-token-12345 are forbidden by AGENTS.md.
_run: BASE=${VELOX_BROKER_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:${VELOX_PORT:-8000}}; jq -c --arg df "${VELOX_DOC_FOLDER:-}" '. as $e | del(._about,._run,._poll) | if $df != "" then .items[0].output |= (. + {drive_folder_id:$df}) else . end' examples/scripts/jackie_chan_generate.json | curl -sS -X POST $BASE/api/script/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer ${VELOX_ADMIN_TOKEN:-}" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'X-Request-ID: jackie-chan-smoke' --data-binary @-
_poll: BASE=${VELOX_BROKER_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:${VELOX_PORT:-8000}}; curl -s $BASE/api/jobs/<job_id>/full -H "Authorization: Bearer $VELOX_ADMIN_TOKEN" | jq -r '.status,.result.script // empty'  # poll every 3s until status in {completed,SUCCEEDED,failed,cancelled}

items.title: Jackie Chan: il fenomeno marziale di Hong Kong
